season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.detail: Defect confirmed: catalog ten.remaining_race_arithmetic said a withdrawn qualifier is replaced by the next alternate, called the series title only, and left the Slam-champion rule unmodelled, but KXATPFINALSQUAL/KXWTAFINALSQUAL rules say 'If player qualifies but does not compete, the market resolves to Yes'. Verified online (ATP rulebook ch. IV 2020/2023 editions via search; 2024 WTA Finals reporting, Krejcikova qualified as Wimbledon champion from outside the top 8): on BOTH tours Race places 1-7 qualify and the 8th place goes to the highest-ranked current-year Grand Slam champion in Race 8-20, else Race 8th; 9-10 are alternates. Patch input_patches/TENNIS_a.json rewrites ten.remaining_race_arithmetic mechanism+measurement (calendar Race, no drop-offs, Q = top 7 + Slam-champion 8th place, no withdrawal reduction, promoted alternate not counted pending Kalshi precedent) and ten.career_major_count_state measurement (current-year champion set feeding the exemption); season_ranking s1 now uses ten.career_major_count_state. Alternate-promotion settlement stays open in the record.
